title: A Holiday Diary
description: Practise past simple, past continuous and holiday words, then write a diary entry.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your diary entry in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🏖️ Monday: We ___ to the seaside by train.
exercises.explanation: Use the past simple for finished actions: travelled.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: I ___ (swim) in the sea in the afternoon.
exercises.explanation: "Swim" is irregular. The past simple is "swam".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.
exercises.explanation: Subject + past verb + in + place: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: It was hot and the sun ___ brightly.
exercises.explanation: Use "was shining" to describe the weather at that time.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Tuesday: We goed to the market and bought some shells.
answers: Tuesday: We went to the market and bought some shells.
exercises.explanation: "Go" is irregular. The past simple is "went".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: 🌊 While I ___ (build) a sandcastle, a big wave came.
exercises.explanation: Use "was + verb-ing" for the longer action.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We met a boy ___ was from Canada.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for people.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Did you enjoy the boat trip.
exercises.explanation: "Did" + subject + base verb: Did you enjoy the boat trip?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The sea was ___ than the swimming pool at home.
exercises.explanation: Use "warmer" with "than".

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word NICER. Begin: "The ..."
exercises.text: The hotel was not as nice as the beach.
answers: The beach was nicer than the hotel.
exercises.explanation: "A is not as nice as B" means "B is nicer than A".

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
exercises.text: We got up ___ six o'clock to see the sunrise.
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Wednesday: It didn't rained, so we went on a long walk.
answers: Wednesday: It didn't rain, so we went on a long walk.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" we use the base verb: didn't rain.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I ___ never eaten fresh seafood before this holiday.
exercises.explanation: Use "have" with I: I have never eaten.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Dad took lots of photos of the sunset.
exercises.explanation: Subject + took + photos: Dad took lots of photos of the sunset.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I was tired ___ I slept very well.
exercises.explanation: "So" shows the result.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the adjective in brackets.
exercises.text: 🍦 This was the ___ (good) ice cream I have ever eaten!
exercises.explanation: "Good" is irregular. The superlative is "the best".

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word GOING. Begin: "Tomorrow ..."
exercises.text: My plan for tomorrow is to visit the old lighthouse.
answers: Tomorrow I am going to visit the old lighthouse.
Tomorrow I'm going to visit the old lighthouse.
exercises.explanation: "Going to" talks about plans.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Friday: I sleeped late and then I ate breakfast on the balcony.
answers: Friday: I slept late and then I ate breakfast on the balcony.
exercises.explanation: "Sleep" is irregular. The past simple is "slept".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We ___ see dolphins from the boat. It was amazing!
exercises.explanation: "Could" is the past of "can".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form: I think I ___ remember this holiday for ever.
exercises.text: 💭 I think I ___ remember this holiday for ever.
exercises.explanation: Use "will" for a prediction about the future.

task.prompt: Write a diary entry about one day of your holiday.
contentPoints: Say what you did in the morning and afternoon.
Say what the weather was like.
usefulLanguage: In the morning ... In the afternoon ...
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Diary,

Today was a fantastic day at the seaside. In the morning we walked along the beach and I found some beautiful shells. It was sunny and hot, so in the afternoon I swam in the sea with my brother. Later we ate fish and rice in a small restaurant. I felt very happy because I love the sea. Tomorrow we are going to visit an island.

Goodnight!
Linh
